title: Breadboard Rise Reading Rise Percent Leaderboard
dataSources: Sourdough monitor (`sourdough:reading`), BBQ/sous-vide probes (`bbq:probe`), fridge/freezer/oven temperature (`kitchen:appliance`), espresso shots (`espresso:shot`), pantry inventory (`pantry:item`), kombucha brew (`kombucha:reading`).
app: ESP32/ESPHome kitchen sensors (sourdough rise, BBQ/sous-vide probes, fridge/freezer temperature), espresso-shot logs, and pantry inventory via MQTT and Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=breadboard:rise rise_pct=*
| stats sum(rise_pct) as total_value, avg(rise_pct) as avg_value by batch_id
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks batch values by total and average rise percent across Breadboard rise reading events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `rise_pct` values for each Breadboard rise reading event and review total and average rise percent by batch.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total rise percent.
grandmaExplanation: It usefully which batch shows the biggest rise percent numbers in your Breadboard rise reading data.
